attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[],"voice":1,"clarity":2,"tone":2,"overall":1,"comment":"The output breaks character by printing the briefing headings (\"News since your last bulletin:\", \"Already reported:\") and parrots the instruction \"A quiet week is a fine story\" in a week that isn't quiet. It also recycles the earlier bulletins' arithmetic and \"politely\" jokes almost verbatim, and it re-presents the old Fenwick razing alongside the genuinely new siege."}
